annotation.title_clean: Enrolled Act No. 32, House Bill HB0102 (Wyoming 2026): Artificial Intelligence Criminal Offenses and Developer Liability
annotation.title_en: Enrolled Act No. 32, House Bill HB0102 (Wyoming 2026): Artificial Intelligence Criminal Offenses and Developer Liability
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Wyoming Legislature (Sixty-Eighth Legislature, House of Representatives)
annotation.summary_en: Wyoming's 2026 enrolled act (HB0102) provides that using AI to commit a crime is no defense, criminalizes nonconsensual synthetic sexual material, AI-generated child pornography, and developing AI to promote self-harm, and grants AI developers limited immunity for third-party misuse. Effective July 1, 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Use of an AI system to commit an offense is not a defense to criminal charges.
Distributing nonconsensual synthetic sexual material is a felony (up to 10 years; 12 for repeat offenses).
Developing or distributing AI designed for child pornography or to promote self-harm is a felony up to 10 years.
AI developers are immune from damages for third-party illegal use unless the system's primary purpose was illicit.
